rv.q: Now for the bad news about Thea Sharrock’s production.
Fans of the movie, Whitney Houston or theatre in general will find plenty to enjoy in ‘The Bodyguard.’ Not quite perfect, but easily good enough to ensure I will always love this show.
‘The Bodyguard Musical’ provides a fun, enjoyable evening and excels in its choreography. Thornton and Emily-Mae’s vocals are outstanding, and Callaghan’s comedic timing is impeccable.
